tldr: 台積電 2 奈米量產登場，Google 搶先蘋果拿下首發，漲價潮更蔓延至成熟製程；AI 供應鏈仍是本周台積電法說前的市場主軸。
台股上周重挫 1,426 點、三度叩關月線失利，法人連賣，多頭整軍待台積電法說「神救援」。
國銀上半年財管業務亮眼，受惠美股與台股 AI 熱潮，兆豐銀相關手續費收入年增約四成。
金管會核准兩樁指標整併案：永豐銀併京城銀、玉山金以股份轉換取得三商美邦人壽 100% 股權。
美伊在荷姆茲海峽再度交火，油價走高；市場則認為今年多頭行情愈來愈靠 AI、而非油價撐盤。

items.title_zh: 台股守穩 4 萬 5、環球晶拿下美光長約
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks hold 45,000 as GlobalWafers lands a Micron long-term deal
items.summary_zh: 經歷震盪的一周後，台股盤前聚焦能否守住 4 萬 5 大關並重返月線之上。盤前要聞以環球晶為亮點：公司與美光簽下多年期供應長約，並取得約 5 億美元資金挹注協助擴產，凸顯記憶體與矽晶圓超級循環正外溢至台灣供應鏈。在本周台積電法說與美國通膨數據接連登場下，投資人偏向謹慎布局，靜待指標訊號再決定加碼方向。
items.summary_en: Ahead of Monday's open, the Taiex was working to defend the 45,000 level and reclaim its monthly moving average after a bruising week. Pre-market headlines centred on GlobalWafers, which secured a multi-year supply agreement with Micron alongside a US$500 million commitment to help fund capacity expansion, underscoring how the memory and silicon-wafer up-cycle is spilling into Taiwan's supply chain. Investors were positioning cautiously into a data-heavy week that includes TSMC's earnings and key US inflation prints.

items.title_zh: 台股周跌 1,426 點、三攻月線失利
items.title_en: Taiex sheds 1,426 points as third assault on the monthly line fails
items.summary_zh: 台股上周重挫 1,426 點，並第三度在月線前鎩羽，技術面轉趨脆弱。市場形容多頭「整軍待援」，寄望台積電法說會成為扭轉盤勢的關鍵催化劑。這波回檔反映強漲後的獲利了結，以及面對密集總經事件的觀望心態；交易員擔心若 AI 族群走弱、外資續賣，回檔恐在權值股法說給出方向前進一步擴大，因此短線操作偏向保守。
items.summary_en: Last week the index tumbled 1,426 points and was rejected for a third time at its monthly moving average, leaving the market technically fragile. Bulls are described as "regrouping" while awaiting TSMC's earnings call to act as a potential rescue catalyst. The retreat reflected profit-taking after a strong run and caution ahead of a cluster of macro events, with traders wary that a weak lead from the AI complex could deepen the pullback before the heavyweight results provide fresh direction.

items.title_zh: 三大法人連賣、投信反手狂掃 16 檔
items.title_en: Institutional trio turn net sellers as investment trusts hunt bargains
items.summary_zh: 反彈派對暫歇，台股三大法人轉為賣方，但投信卻逆勢加碼，狂掃包含南亞科、廣達等 16 檔「壓箱寶」個股。這種分歧凸顯多空對行情的看法：究竟是漲勢到頂、還是高檔整理。投信似乎趁回檔布局其視為長線核心的 AI 伺服器與記憶體個股，即便外資與自營商資金態度轉趨防禦，仍反映法人對後市結構性題材的信心並未鬆動。
items.summary_en: The rebound party paused as Taiwan's three major institutional investors moved to the sell side, yet local investment trusts went the other way, scooping up 16 favoured names including Nanya Technology and Quanta. The divergence highlights a rotation debate: whether the recent surge has run its course or is merely consolidating. Trusts appear to be using the dip to accumulate AI-server and memory plays they view as core long-term holdings, even as foreign and dealer flows stay defensive.

items.title_zh: 台積電 2 奈米 Google 搶先蘋果首發
items.title_en: Google jumps the queue on TSMC's 2nm, beating Apple to first chip
items.summary_zh: 台積電 2 奈米開始量產，點燃智慧手機 2 奈米處理器大戰，令人意外的是，Google 破天荒搶到頭香。Google 將於 8 月中旬推出搭載自家 Tensor G6 處理器的 Pixel 11 系列新機，該處理器由台積電 2 奈米打造，時程比蘋果還早，打破以往蘋果拔頭籌的慣例。此舉顯示晶片設計巨頭對台積電先進製程產能的競逐愈演愈烈，也可能牽動整個產業對旗艦手機推出節奏的預期，後續各家排單與量產進度值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: With TSMC's 2nm process entering volume production, the race for 2nm smartphone processors has ignited — and, in a surprise, Google grabbed pole position. Google plans to launch its Pixel 11 series in mid-August powered by an in-house Tensor G6 built on TSMC's 2nm, ahead of Apple, breaking the long-standing convention that Apple debuts each new node first. The move signals intensifying competition among fabless giants for TSMC's leading-edge capacity and could reshape flagship-phone timing expectations across the industry.

items.title_zh: 台積電漲價潮蔓延至成熟製程
items.title_en: TSMC's price hikes spread from leading edge to mature nodes
items.summary_zh: 台積電先進製程接單爆滿、持續調高 3 奈米報價之際，漲價潮進一步蔓延至成熟製程。多家 IC 設計業者透露，陸續收到台積電擬調高成熟製程價格的通知，個別客戶漲幅不一，預計明年元月生效。此舉替聯電、力積電、世界先進等同業打了定心丸，後續可望跟進調漲。整體反映 AI 帶動的強勁需求已使全製程產能吃緊，不再侷限於尖端節點，成熟製程供需與報價走勢將成為下半年觀察半導體景氣的重要指標。
items.summary_en: With advanced-process order books full and 3nm quotes already rising, TSMC is now extending price increases to mature nodes. Several IC design houses say they have received notices of higher mature-node pricing, with the increases varying by customer and set to take effect from January next year. The move gives foundry peers such as UMC, Powerchip and Vanguard breathing room to follow with their own hikes, signalling that robust AI-driven demand is tightening capacity across the entire process spectrum, not just at the cutting edge.

items.title_zh: 美中機器人爭霸 帶旺台鏈拉貨潮
items.title_en: US–China robot rivalry sparks a new wave of Taiwan-chain orders
items.summary_zh: 美、中機器人巨頭大車拚，台鏈得利。美國以特斯拉為代表，執行長馬斯克宣示全力衝刺第三代 Optimus 人形機器人量產，帶旺盟立、亞光等協力廠；大陸則由宇樹領銜衝鋒，並啟動首次公開發行（IPO），後續銀彈上膛可望加速擴產。雙陣營同步推進人形機器人量產，帶動台灣零組件與系統整合廠新一波拉貨潮，所羅門等業者亦受惠。市場看好機器人供應鏈成為繼 AI 伺服器後另一條中長線成長主軸，相關個股訂單能見度與良率進展值得留意。
items.summary_en: Robotics titans in the US and China are going head-to-head, and Taiwan's supply chain is reaping the benefits. On the US side, Tesla's Elon Musk has pledged an all-out push to mass-produce the third-generation Optimus humanoid, boosting partners such as Mirle Automation and Genius Electronic Optical; in China, Unitree is leading the charge and has kicked off an IPO to raise fresh ammunition. The dual-front build-out is driving a new pull-in of orders for Taiwanese component and integration players positioned across both ecosystems.

items.title_zh: 航空雙雄迎貨運大旺季 Q4 運價可望再攀峰
items.title_en: Air-cargo duo brace for a peak season that's "only just begun"
items.summary_zh: AI 出貨潮升溫，全球航空貨運迎來大旺季。業者預期今年貨運旺季「才剛開始」，在 AI 基礎建設投資持續擴大、電子業旺季、開學季及年底節慶備貨接力帶動下，第 3 季艙位供給吃緊，第 4 季運價可望再攀高峰。長榮航、華航營運展望轉趨樂觀，對後市釋出正向訊號。除客運復甦外，貨運高運價可望成為航空雙雄下半年獲利的重要支撐，市場關注旺季艙位調度與運價能否延續強勢，並留意油價波動對成本結構的影響。
items.summary_en: A surge in AI shipments is powering a booming peak season for global air freight. Carriers expect this year's high season to be just getting started: sustained AI-infrastructure investment, an electronics up-cycle, back-to-school demand and year-end holiday stocking are set to keep cargo capacity tight through the third quarter, with fourth-quarter freight rates likely to scale fresh highs. EVA Air and China Airlines are positioned to benefit, and management commentary on the outlook has turned notably upbeat as belly-and-freighter demand strengthens.

items.title_zh: 記憶體好光景到頭？美銀示警「產能騙局」
items.title_en: BofA warns of a memory "capacity mirage" as boom questions surface
items.summary_zh: 美銀拆解記憶體上行循環背後的數字，示警所謂「產能騙局」，並質疑好光景能否延續。報告聚焦南亞科、華邦電、旺宏等台廠是否還能維持當前接單接到手軟的熱度，提醒帳面產能與需求數字恐高估了實際強度。此份報告在記憶體族群強勢重評價之際發布，替市場注入一劑冷靜劑。適逢南亞科法說登場，投資人須在超級循環的樂觀情緒與供給端潛在雜訊間拿捏；後續 DDR 報價、庫存去化與長約能見度，將是驗證記憶體行情續航力的關鍵。
items.summary_en: Bank of America has dissected the numbers behind the memory upturn, warning of what it calls a "capacity mirage" and questioning whether the good times can last. The report scrutinises whether Taiwanese memory makers Nanya Technology, Winbond and Macronix can keep booking orders at their current torrid pace, cautioning that headline capacity and demand figures may overstate underlying strength. The note lands as the sector rides a powerful re-rating, injecting a dose of caution into an otherwise euphoric memory trade ahead of Nanya's earnings call.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准永豐銀併京城銀
items.title_en: Regulator clears SinoPac's merger with King's Town Bank
items.summary_zh: 金管會正式核准永豐商業銀行合併京城商業銀行，替國內銀行業眾所矚目的整併案掃除關鍵法規障礙。此案通過後，永豐銀可擴大分行版圖與客群，尤其強化在京城銀深耕的南台灣市場布局。這樁合併反映主管機關持續鼓勵中型銀行透過整併壯大規模，以打造更具競爭力、資本更厚實的本國銀行體系。在銀行家數偏多、競爭激烈的環境下，後續合併綜效發揮、系統與人員整合進度，將是市場評估此案成敗的重點。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission has approved Bank SinoPac's merger with King's Town Bank, greenlighting one of the more closely watched consolidation deals in Taiwan's crowded banking sector. The approval clears a key regulatory hurdle for a tie-up that expands SinoPac's branch footprint and customer base, particularly in southern Taiwan where King's Town has deep roots. The deal reflects continued official encouragement of scale-building among mid-sized banks as authorities push for a more competitive, better-capitalised domestic banking industry.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准玉山金取得三商美邦人壽 100% 股權
items.title_en: E.Sun to take full ownership of Mercuries Life via share swap
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准玉山金控以股份轉換方式取得三商美邦人壽 100% 股權，象徵集團版圖大幅跨入壽險領域。此案讓以銀行為核心的玉山金拓展業務組合，在金控積極尋求多元化、可交叉銷售的營運布局之際，補足壽險規模。完全納入三商美邦人壽後，玉山金資產負債表擴大、商品貨架更完整。不過壽險業資本結構與長天期負債特性，使得後續營運整合、避險與資本管理成為市場關注焦點，投資人將觀察併購綜效與對集團獲利、股東權益的實際影響。
items.summary_en: The FSC has approved E.Sun Financial Holding's plan to acquire 100% of Mercuries Life through a share-swap structure, marking a significant expansion of the group's footprint into life insurance. The deal broadens E.Sun beyond its banking core, adding scale in insurance at a time when financial holding companies are seeking diversified, cross-sell-friendly business mixes. Bringing Mercuries Life fully in-house gives E.Sun a larger balance sheet and a wider product shelf, though integration of insurance operations and capital management will be watched closely.

items.title_zh: 金融業 5 月忙收割 壽險狂砍逾千億台股
items.title_en: Insurers slash NT$100 billion-plus of Taiwan stocks as sector harvests gains
items.summary_zh: 台股連兩月狂飆後，金融業 5 月由進攻轉向收割。據金管會統計，金融三業 5 月單月減碼台股 751 億元，寫近半年最大；銀行、券商縮手，壽險業更反手大砍 1,331 億元。實現的股票資本利得可轉列保留盈餘，增加日後配息籌碼。同時金融業債市布局轉趨保守。此舉反映法人在高檔獲利入袋、調整資產配置的節奏，也牽動後續台股籌碼結構與金融股股利政策，市場關注壽險資金是否於回檔後重新回補，以及利率走勢對債券部位評價的影響。
items.summary_en: After two months of surging share prices, Taiwan's financial industry switched from offence to profit-taking in May. FSC data show the three financial sub-sectors net-trimmed NT$75.1 billion of Taiwan equities in the month — the largest cutback in nearly half a year — as banks and brokerages pulled back and life insurers reversed course to dump NT$133.1 billion. The realised capital gains can be converted into retained earnings, boosting insurers' ammunition for future dividend payouts even as they turn more conservative on their bond-market positioning.

items.title_zh: 醫療理賠增加 壽險新挑戰 新壽籲建立一致認定標準
items.title_en: Life insurers face fresh medical-claims pressure, new challenges
items.summary_zh: 台灣人口結構轉變，持續為壽險業帶來新挑戰。新光人壽總經理黃敏義指出，今年上半年死亡理賠比預期少，但死亡理賠減少不代表整體理賠壓力降低；隨著「醫療通膨」及新式醫療技術發展，包括癌症標靶治療、新式手術等，醫療相關理賠正持續攀升。他呼籲主管機關建立一致的認定標準，示警各方對理賠適用範圍認定不一，已成為壽險業經營長天期負債的結構性難題。此議題攸關保單成本與商品設計，後續金管會與業者如何取得共識值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's shifting population structure continues to test life insurers. Shin Kong Life president Huang Min-yi noted that while death-benefit claims in the first half came in lower than expected, that does not mean overall claims pressure has eased: "medical inflation" and advancing treatments — including cancer targeted therapies and new surgical techniques — are pushing health-related payouts higher. He urged regulators to establish consistent standards for adjudicating claims, warning that inconsistent interpretation of what qualifies for reimbursement is becoming a structural headache for insurers managing long-tail liabilities.

items.title_zh: 國銀上半年財管業務亮眼 兆豐手續費年增四成
items.title_en: Bank wealth-management fees shine in H1; Mega Bank's up about 40%
items.summary_zh: 今年上半年本國銀行財富管理業務普遍繳出亮眼成績單。截至 6 月底，在美股與台股 AI 熱潮持續帶動，以及銀行客戶分群經營策略下，多家國銀財管手續費淨收益呈雙位數成長，其中兆豐銀與第一銀行上半年財管總量表現突出，兆豐相關手續費收入年增約四成。此成績凸顯多頭市場與高資產客戶參與度提升，正讓收費型財管業務成為國銀愈來愈重要的獲利支柱。對財管業者而言，如何在行情回檔時維持客戶黏著度與商品配置動能，將是下半年手續費收入能否延續成長的關鍵。
items.summary_en: Domestic banks turned in strong first-half wealth-management results. As of end-June, sustained AI-driven rallies in US and Taiwan stocks, combined with banks' customer-segmentation strategies, drove double-digit growth in net wealth-management fee income at multiple lenders. Mega Bank and First Bank posted particularly strong first-half wealth-management totals, with Mega's related fee income up about 40% year-on-year. The results underline how buoyant markets and rising high-net-worth engagement are making fee-based wealth management an increasingly important earnings pillar for Taiwan's banks.

items.title_zh: 台壽攜中信投信推類全委帳戶 兼顧傳承與退休金流
items.title_en: Cathay Life and CTBC Investments launch discretionary account for succession and retirement
items.summary_zh: 中信金控子公司台灣人壽「信鑫滿滿」系列保單攜手中信投信，推出「全球領航」新臺幣類全委帳戶。此雙平台商品鎖定台灣供應鏈與美國科技龍頭企業，透過主動與被動 ETF 靈活配置的優勢建立部位，定位為同時滿足資產傳承與退休金流需求。此案反映壽險與資產管理業者正將類全委、以 ETF 為核心的解決方案包裝上市，回應高資產與退休族群對世代傳承及穩定退休現金流的規劃需求。對財管顧問而言，可作為連結保險保障與投資配置、切入傳承規劃議題的實務工具，惟仍須留意市場波動對帳戶淨值與撥回機制的影響。
items.summary_en: CTBC Financial's subsidiary Taiwan Life has teamed up with CTBC Investments to roll out a New Taiwan dollar discretionary ("quasi-mandate") account under its "Xin Xin Man Man" insurance series. The dual-platform product targets Taiwan's supply chain and US tech leaders, using a flexible mix of active and passive ETFs to build exposure. Positioned to serve both wealth-succession and retirement-income needs, the offering reflects how insurers and asset managers are packaging discretionary, ETF-based solutions to meet demand from clients planning intergenerational transfers and stable retirement cash flows.

items.title_zh: 高股息 ETF 混搭 打造「月月領息」現金流
items.title_en: Investors chase "monthly dividend" cash flow via high-yield ETF combos
items.summary_zh: 在存股族對現金流需求高漲下，理財達人傳授如何以 0056、00878、00918、00919 等熱門台股高股息 ETF 混搭，打造「月月領息」現金流。由於這些 ETF 配息時程錯開，透過搭配可將配息平滑為近乎按月入帳的收入來源。此策略反映高股息 ETF 在台灣存股族間歷久不衰的人氣，滿足對被動收入的追求。不過顧問提醒，追逐配息率仍須與總報酬、股價波動及各檔配息的可持續性一併衡量，避免只看高息、忽略本金與填息風險，才能真正達到穩健領息的目標。
items.summary_en: Amid strong retail appetite for income, financial commentators are teaching investors how to build a "month-after-month" dividend cash flow by mixing popular Taiwan high-yield ETFs such as 0056, 00878, 00918 and 00919. Because these funds pay distributions on staggered schedules, blending them can smooth payouts into a near-monthly income stream. The strategy reflects the enduring popularity of high-dividend ETFs among Taiwanese savers seeking passive income, though advisers caution that yield chasing must be weighed against total return, price volatility and the sustainability of each fund's distributions.

items.title_zh: 月領退休金全年 89.4 萬免稅 一次領按服務年資計算
items.title_en: Monthly pensions tax-free up to NT$894,000 a year; lump sums by years of service
items.summary_zh: 財政部提醒，民眾領取退休金是否課稅，要看是否超過免稅額度。若採分期領取，以 2026 年標準來看，全年定額免稅 89.4 萬元；若採一次領取，則依服務年資計算免稅額；若部分分期、部分一次領，則須分別按比率設算。此提醒有助退休族規劃提領的時點與方式，藉由分期或一次領的組合安排，妥善控管稅負。對財富傳承與退休規劃而言，退休金課稅方式攸關實際可支配金額，建議提早試算不同提領情境，並搭配整體資產配置，避免因一次領取跳增稅級而侵蝕退休準備。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance reminds the public that whether pension income is taxable depends on whether it exceeds the exemption threshold. For those drawing pensions in instalments, the 2026 standard sets a flat annual tax-free amount of NT$894,000; for lump-sum withdrawals, the exemption is calculated according to years of service; and for mixed instalment-plus-lump-sum arrangements, the two portions must be assessed separately on a pro-rata basis. The guidance helps retirees plan the timing and structure of withdrawals to manage their tax exposure efficiently.

items.title_zh: 迎 AI 浪潮 家族資產重整四策略
items.title_en: Family-asset restructuring: four strategies for the AI wave
items.summary_zh: 在 AI 帶動投資熱潮與全球市場結構轉變的背景下，稅務與傳承專家提出高資產家族進行資產重整的四大策略。此架構涵蓋家族如何重新配置持股以對接新的成長主題、管理跨境稅務曝險，以及建立信託、控股載具等具韌性的傳承結構。相關建議反映台灣富裕家庭對主動規劃的需求日增：一方面掌握 AI 等大趨勢帶來的投資機會，另一方面兼顧稅務效率與世代間有序移轉。對財管與傳承顧問而言，如何協助客戶在追求成長題材的同時，透過適當的持有架構與稅務安排降低潛在風險，是深化家族客戶關係的關鍵切入點。
items.summary_en: Against a backdrop of an AI-driven investment boom and shifting global markets, tax and estate specialists outline four strategies for high-net-worth families looking to restructure their assets. The framework addresses how families can reorganise holdings to align with new growth themes, manage cross-border tax exposure, and build durable succession structures such as trusts and holding vehicles. The guidance reflects growing demand among wealthy Taiwanese households for proactive planning that balances investment opportunity from megatrends like AI against tax efficiency and orderly intergenerational transfer.

items.title_zh: 自用住宅用地適用順序大有學問 省稅撇步公開
items.title_en: Priority order of self-use residential land holds hidden tax-saving keys
items.summary_zh: 稅務專家提醒，自用住宅用地享受優惠的「適用順序」暗藏可觀且常被忽略的省稅空間。由於現行規定對特定自用住宅用地優惠設有上限與優先順位，家戶在多筆房地間主張免稅或優惠稅率的先後順序，將實質影響最終的地價稅與交易相關稅負。此提醒鼓勵擁有多筆符合資格房地的屋主，審慎規劃適用順序，確保取得最大可用的稅負減免，而非任其套用到相對不利的組合。對高資產家庭而言，房地資產配置與持有架構的稅務細節，往往是傳承與節稅規劃中容易被低估的一環，值得與專業顧問逐案試算。
items.summary_en: Tax specialists highlight that the order in which self-use residential land is applied for preferential treatment carries significant, and often overlooked, tax-saving implications. Because Taiwan's rules cap and prioritise certain self-use land benefits, the sequence in which a household claims exemptions or reduced rates across multiple properties can materially change the final land-tax and transaction-tax burden. The reminder encourages homeowners with more than one qualifying property to plan the application order deliberately, ensuring they capture the maximum available relief rather than defaulting to a sub-optimal arrangement.

items.title_zh: 青安 3.0 補貼將不隨升息加碼 寬限期成最終拉鋸
items.title_en: New youth-housing subsidy won't rise with rate hikes; grace period the final sticking point
items.summary_zh: 財政部規劃的青安 3.0 方案，最快本周再向行政院長卓榮泰報告。各方意見已逐漸收斂，最終拉鋸關鍵在於寬限期是否維持五年。跨部會初步共識為：未來若中央銀行升息，住宅基金將不再隨之加碼補貼，與現行設計相比是明顯轉變；且 8 月起所有青安房貸補貼都將減碼，顯示政策朝更具財政永續性的方向調整。此舉牽動首購族購屋成本與房市買氣，市場關注寬限期最終版本，以及補貼縮減對房貸需求與銀行放款結構的實際影響。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance's "Youth Peace of Mind 3.0" housing plan is set to go back to Premier Cho Jung-tai as early as this week. Views have largely converged, with the final tussle over whether to keep the five-year grace period. In a preliminary cross-ministry consensus, the housing fund will no longer add extra subsidy in step with future central bank rate hikes — a notable change from the current design. From August, subsidies on all youth housing loans are set to be trimmed, marking a shift toward a more fiscally sustainable programme.

items.title_zh: 軍公教調薪拍板 明年加薪 4%、專業加給大增
items.title_en: Public-sector pay raise finalised: 4% next year, allowances up sharply
items.summary_zh: 政府拍板軍公教調薪方案。自 7 月起，專業與主管加給調增 2,000 元，明年並將調薪 4%，專業加給估飆升約 20%，牽動約 160 億元經費。此方案旨在於勞動市場緊俏之際，強化公部門的人才招募與留任，並協助收入跟上生活成本，同時替政府人事預算新增可觀支出。對總體經濟而言，公部門調薪具指標意義，可能牽動民間薪資談判與消費動能；後續須觀察加薪對財政負擔、物價預期及整體薪資結構的連鎖影響。
items.summary_en: The government has finalised its salary package for military personnel, civil servants and public-school teachers. From July, professional and supervisory allowances are being raised by NT$2,000, with a broader 4% pay increase set for next year and professional allowances estimated to jump around 20% — a change that affects roughly NT$16 billion in expenditure. The package aims to bolster public-sector recruitment and retention amid a tight labour market and to help incomes keep pace with living costs, while adding a meaningful new line item to the government's personnel budget.

items.title_zh: 前五月實質薪資六年最佳 主計總處：AI 紅利發酵
items.title_en: Real wages in first five months best in six years as AI dividend feeds through
items.summary_zh: 主計總處指出，今年前五月實質經常性薪資創六年最佳，並歸因於「AI 紅利」在經濟體中逐步發酵。資訊電子業受 AI 帶動獲利大增，推升相關產業薪資與加班，但官方也坦言，科技聚落以外的多數勞工對這波榮景幾乎無感。數據凸顯勞動市場「雙軌化」加劇，薪資增長集中於 AI 相關製造業。此現象牽動所得分配與消費結構，也成為政策關注焦點；後續須留意 AI 紅利能否外溢至其他產業，以及薪資成長在物價壓力下的實質購買力表現。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's real regular earnings in the first five months of the year hit their best level in six years, according to the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, which attributes the improvement to the "AI dividend" filtering through the economy. Strong AI-driven profitability in the information-electronics sector has lifted pay and overtime in related industries, even as officials acknowledge that most workers outside the tech complex feel little of the boom. The data underscore an increasingly two-speed labour market, with gains concentrated in AI-linked manufacturing.

items.title_zh: 綠色投融資突破 5 兆元 金管會持續推動轉型金融
items.title_en: Green investment and financing tops NT$5 trillion as FSC pushes transition finance
items.summary_zh: 金管會表示，綠色投融資規模已突破 5 兆元，並將持續推動綠色及轉型金融發展。此里程碑反映銀行、資本市場與保險業對永續連結專案的資金動員持續上升，符合主管機關引導金融體系邁向淨零目標的路徑規劃。金管會釋出訊號，將持續完善相關框架與誘因以支持轉型金融，協助高碳排產業取得減碳所需資金，同時深化綠色金融商品市場。對金融業者而言，綠色與轉型金融既是政策方向，也是新的業務與資產配置機會，惟須兼顧氣候風險評估與資訊揭露品質，避免「漂綠」爭議。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission reports that the scale of green investment and financing has surpassed NT$5 trillion, as it continues to advance green and transition finance in Taiwan. The milestone reflects rising capital mobilisation toward sustainability-linked projects across banking, capital markets and insurance, in line with the regulator's roadmap to steer the financial system toward net-zero goals. The FSC signalled it will keep developing frameworks and incentives to support transition finance, helping carbon-intensive industries fund their decarbonisation while deepening the market for green financial products.

items.title_zh: 美銀揭「四大」逆向投資機會
items.title_en: BofA flags four contrarian trades against the market's "four consensus" views
items.summary_zh: 美國銀行首席投資策略師 Michael Hartnett 警告，市場對美國經濟、聯準會、AI 資本支出及期中選舉形成的「四大共識」，反而可能成為最大風險。他提出四項逆勢交易策略，包括布局美債、美元、黃金，並因應 AI 資本支出可能下修。此觀點呼籲投資人反向操作過度擁擠的共識部位，提醒最大意外往往出現在市場最有信心之處。對資產配置而言，適度納入避險資產、留意 AI 投資動能與聯準會政策轉向的可能性，有助在共識反轉時降低組合波動。
items.summary_en: Bank of America chief investment strategist Michael Hartnett warns that the market's "four big consensus" positions — on the US economy, the Federal Reserve, AI capital spending and the midterm elections — could themselves become the biggest risks. He lays out four contrarian trades in response, including building positions in US Treasuries, the US dollar and gold, and preparing for a downshift in AI capex. The call urges investors to fade crowded assumptions, cautioning that the biggest surprises tend to come from where the consensus is most confident.

items.title_zh: 大摩警告美股夏季行情恐提前結束
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley warns summer rally may end early on "three big risks"
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利警告，美股夏季行情恐因三大風險提前降溫，包括伊朗衝突升溫、聯準會可能升息，以及 AI 資本支出放緩。分析師指出，若科技巨頭在第二季財報透露縮減 AI 投資，加上市場開始質疑 AI 投資報酬率，恐對科技七巨頭與美股帶來新一波衝擊。此份報告呼應華爾街要求在高估值下保持謹慎的聲音。對投資人而言，本周登場的美股財報季將是檢驗 AI 資本支出動能與獲利預期的關鍵，須留意科技權值股法說對後市風向的牽引。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley cautions that the US market's summer rally could cool prematurely due to three key risks: escalating conflict with Iran, the possibility of a Fed rate hike, and a slowdown in AI capital spending. Analysts warn that if tech giants signal a pullback in AI investment during second-quarter earnings, and the market begins to question AI's return on investment, it could deal a fresh blow to the "Magnificent Seven" and US equities more broadly. The note adds to a chorus of Wall Street voices urging caution at elevated valuations.

items.title_zh: 三星龍仁首座晶圓廠投產提前一年
items.title_en: Samsung pulls Yongin fab start-up forward a year to chase AI chips
items.summary_zh: 三星電子宣布，將南韓龍仁半導體國家產業園區首座晶圓廠量產時程提前至 2029 年，較市場預期至少提前一年。三星配合南韓政府加速供電、供水等基礎建設，全力搶攻 AI 晶片需求。龍仁園區未來將建置六座晶圓廠，成為三星下一世代半導體製造核心。此舉凸顯三星在先進製程與 AI 相關產能上，加大力度追趕台積電。對供應鏈而言，龍仁擴產進度、良率與客戶導入情況將牽動全球晶圓代工競局，也影響記憶體與先進封裝的產能配置，值得台廠密切關注。
items.summary_en: Samsung Electronics has announced it will bring forward mass production at the first fab in South Korea's Yongin semiconductor national industrial complex to 2029, at least a year earlier than the market expected. Working with the Korean government's accelerated build-out of power and water infrastructure, Samsung is going all-out to capture surging AI-chip demand. The Yongin complex will eventually house six fabs and become the core of Samsung's next-generation semiconductor manufacturing, intensifying the capacity race against TSMC in advanced-node and AI-related production.

items.title_zh: SK 海力士示警：2027 年全球記憶體恐陷史上最嚴重缺貨
items.title_en: SK Hynix warns of worst-ever global memory shortage by 2027
items.summary_zh: SK 海力士示警，隨 AI 需求緊繃供給，全球恐於 2027 年面臨史上最嚴重的記憶體缺貨。此警告強化記憶體廠的結構性多頭論述，意味 DRAM 與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的供需吃緊，可能延續至當前循環之後。對台灣供應鏈與整體半導體族群而言，此展望代表報價續強與訂單維持高檔，但也引發市場對三星、SK 海力士及中國新進者新增產能能多快填補缺口的疑問。後續 HBM 擴產節奏、先進製程良率與 AI 需求持續性，將是驗證缺貨論述的觀察重點。
items.summary_en: SK Hynix has cautioned that the world could face its most severe memory shortage on record by 2027, as AI-driven demand strains supply. The warning reinforces a bullish structural narrative for memory makers, suggesting that tight conditions in DRAM and high-bandwidth memory could persist well beyond the current cycle. For Taiwanese suppliers and the broader semiconductor complex, the outlook implies continued pricing power and elevated orders — but also raises questions about how quickly new capacity from the likes of Samsung, SK Hynix and Chinese entrants can close the gap.

items.title_zh: 美伊在荷姆茲海峽戰火升級（2026-07-13）
items.title_en: U.S. and Iran Ramp Up Attacks in Fight Over Strait of Hormuz (2026-07-13)
items.summary_zh: 美方周日對荷姆茲海峽附近的伊朗目標發動新一輪打擊，讓周末的交火進一步升級，衝突威脅全球最重要的石油咽喉。戰事再起加深市場對能源供應與全球通膨的疑慮，油價與地緣風險成為本周焦點。
items.summary_en: The U.S. intensified a weekend of exchanges by launching a new round of strikes on Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz on Sunday, escalating a conflict that threatens the world's most important oil chokepoint. The renewed fighting stokes fears over energy supply and global inflation.

items.title_zh: 銀行財報週 Citigroup 最受矚目（2026-07-13）
items.title_en: Why Citigroup Is the One to Watch as Big Banks Report Earnings (2026-07-13)
items.summary_zh: 美國五大銀行同日公布財報，花旗（Citigroup）格外受關注。在大型銀行中，花旗預料將在某項關鍵指標上展現最大幅度改善，但距離自身設定的績效目標仍有一段路要走。其財報將是本周檢視銀行類股體質的重要風向球，牽動投資人對美股財報季開局的看法。
items.summary_en: As five big U.S. banks report earnings on the same day, Citigroup stands out. Among the largest lenders, Citi is expected to show the greatest improvement by one important measure — though it still has a long way to go to reach its own performance target. Its results will be a key read on the sector this week.

items.title_zh: 美股多頭行情愈來愈靠 AI、而非油價（2026-07-12）
items.title_en: The Stock-Market Rally Now Hinges More on AI Than Oil (2026-07-12)
items.summary_zh: 隨財報季開跑，AI 投資仍是美股焦點。分析指出，即便中東情勢緊張，這波行情的走向如今更取決於 AI 支出的軌跡，而非油價波動。這使科技權值股的財報結果格外受矚目，市場關注 AI 資本支出動能能否延續，成為左右美股後市的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: As earnings season kicks off, AI investment remains front and center for the U.S. stock market. Analysis suggests the rally's fate now depends more on the trajectory of AI spending than on swings in oil prices, even amid Middle East tensions — putting tech-heavyweight results under an especially bright spotlight.

items.title_zh: 高層：AI 需求「近乎無限」即便企業轉向「價值極大化」（2026-07-12）
items.title_en: 'Almost Unlimited': Execs Say AI Demand Stays Strong Amid 'Valuemaxxing' (2026-07-12)
items.summary_zh: 在 AI 需求與支出的爭論中，AI 相關晶片股走勢震盪。不過多位高層形容需求「近乎無限」，即便企業開始轉向「valuemaxxing」、力求從 AI 投資中榨出更多價值。這番說法反駁了 AI 資本支出熱潮降溫的疑慮，替市場對 AI 需求前景注入信心，也呼應本周科技財報的觀察重點。
items.summary_en: AI-related chip stocks have been volatile amid a debate over AI demand and spending. Yet executives describe demand as "almost unlimited," even as enterprises shift toward "valuemaxxing" — squeezing more value from their AI investments. The comments push back against fears that the AI capex boom is cooling.

items.title_zh: 調查：多數美國勞工支持設 AI 主權財富基金（2026-07-12）
items.title_en: Majority of U.S. Workers Support an AI Wealth Fund as Tech Layoffs Surge (2026-07-12)
items.summary_zh: 隨科技業裁員增加，最新調查顯示，多數美國受僱者希望成立 AI 主權財富基金，以促使企業承擔更多責任。此結果反映勞工對自動化與工作保障的焦慮升高，也讓「AI 帶來的利得應如何分配」的辯論再度升溫，成為政策與企業治理的新議題。
items.summary_en: A majority of U.S. employees now want an AI sovereign wealth fund to hold corporations more accountable, according to a recent survey, as tech layoffs rise. The finding reflects growing worker anxiety over automation and job security, and adds to the debate over how the gains from AI should be shared.

items.title_zh: 蘋果控告 OpenAI 後 馬斯克與奧特曼再槓上（2026-07-13）
items.title_en: Musk and Altman Spar on X After Apple Files OpenAI Lawsuit (2026-07-13)
items.summary_zh: 蘋果對 OpenAI 提告後，馬斯克與 OpenAI 執行長奧特曼在 X 上公開交鋒。奧特曼稱，馬斯克在 OpenAI 本周稍早發布新模型後又對他念念不忘。這場口水戰再度點燃 AI 產業兩位要角之間的長期恩怨，也反映 AI 模型與人才競逐的白熱化。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk and Sam Altman clashed publicly on X after Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI. Altman insisted that Musk was again obsessed with him following an OpenAI model release earlier in the week, reigniting a long-running feud between two of the most prominent figures in the AI industry.

items.title_zh: 本季財報預估出現不尋常型態（2026-07-12）
items.title_en: Earnings Estimates Are Following an Unusual Pattern This Time (2026-07-12)
items.summary_zh: 分析師通常在財報前數月調降預估，但這一輪受能源與科技類股帶動，第二季財報前的獲利預期反而上修。這種罕見的情況墊高了企業要打動投資人所需跨越的門檻，若實際表現未能超越已被拉高的預期，股價恐承壓，是本周財報季須留意的風險。
items.summary_en: Analysts typically lower their estimates in the months before earnings. But this cycle, thanks to the energy and technology sectors, expectations have actually climbed heading into second-quarter results — an unusual setup that raises the bar companies must clear to impress investors.

items.title_zh: 共和黨重量級參議員葛拉漢辭世 享壽 71 歲（2026-07-12）
items.title_en: Lindsey Graham, Influential GOP Senator, Dies at 71 (2026-07-12)
items.summary_zh: 具影響力的南卡羅來納州共和黨參議員、外交鷹派代表人物葛拉漢（Lindsey Graham），因突發疾病辭世，享壽 71 歲，稍早才結束烏克蘭行程。身為川普的重要盟友，他的離世讓美國外交與國防政策失去一個關鍵聲音，各界表達哀悼。
items.summary_en: Lindsey Graham, the influential Republican senator from South Carolina and a prominent foreign-policy hawk, has died at 71 after a brief illness, having just returned from a trip to Ukraine. A key Trump ally, his death removes a significant voice on U.S. foreign and defense policy.
